title: Step 9b sends each page's customer-visible faults to the site agent as one numbered comment turn, undoes a turn that made a page worse, and hands over the written site on any error
steps: S1: Run the step 9 entry point tests with the site agent faked: node --test --test-concurrency=1 apps/tracy-web/test/write-step-nine-repair.test.mjs.
S2: Run the finder, finder door and bench command tests one file at a time: write-step-finder, door-ladder, write-step-bench-repair-cli.
expect: S1: every test passes: each fault is sent once with page, element and sentence; one turn per page; excluded kinds are never sent; a turn causing a new blocking failure is undone newest first; a prompt with no turn is resent once then dropped; one resend round; no new work after 10 minutes and a return by 12; any error hands over the written site with the first check; no faults means no turn.
fence: The step 9 entry point's repair pass: what it sends to the site agent, what it undoes and what it hands over, checked with a fake site agent
